accounts.name: Daily checking
accounts.note: Entirely fictional demonstration for Rowan Vale, a single employed adult. All identities, institutions and financial events are invented. Take-home pay and household bills; no opening balance or imported personal records.

accounts.name: Project checking
accounts.note: Entirely fictional demonstration for Rowan Vale, a single employed adult. All identities, institutions and financial events are invented. A short-lived account for occasional freelance work; swept and closed May 29, 2026.

accounts.name: Starter reserve
accounts.note: Entirely fictional demonstration for Rowan Vale, a single employed adult. All identities, institutions and financial events are invented. Moved to the high-yield reserve September 10, 2024; closing interest and the final transfer are recorded.

accounts.name: Emergency reserve
accounts.note: Entirely fictional demonstration for Rowan Vale, a single employed adult. All identities, institutions and financial events are invented. A later savings account funded by Transfers, with simulated daily-balance interest posted monthly.

accounts.name: Completed 12-month CD
accounts.note: Entirely fictional demonstration for Rowan Vale, a single employed adult. All identities, institutions and financial events are invented. Fictional $1,500 deposit; interest credited monthly; full payout and closure June 19, 2025.

accounts.name: Current 12-month CD
accounts.note: Entirely fictional demonstration for Rowan Vale, a single employed adult. All identities, institutions and financial events are invented. Fictional $3,000 deposit; interest credited monthly; contractual maturity March 11, 2027, after this demo cutoff. No future payout is recorded.

accounts.name: Long-term investments
accounts.note: Entirely fictional demonstration for Rowan Vale, a single employed adult. All identities, institutions and financial events are invented. Fictional fund baskets at recorded purchase cost, with profitable, loss-making and break-even full-holding sales. No market valuations.

accounts.name: Treasury ladder
accounts.note: Entirely fictional demonstration for Rowan Vale, a single employed adult. All identities, institutions and financial events are invented. Fictional Treasury bill examples; three actual redemptions and one active bill. No real security identifier or brokerage record is used.

accounts.name: Everyday rewards card
accounts.note: Entirely fictional demonstration for Rowan Vale, a single employed adult. All identities, institutions and financial events are invented. Calendar-month statement cycles. Prior-cycle repayments are Transfers; October 2026 debt remains outstanding at the cutoff.

accounts.name: Travel and experiences card
accounts.note: Entirely fictional demonstration for Rowan Vale, a single employed adult. All identities, institutions and financial events are invented. A later card with annual fees and a cancelled-trip refund. A small card credit at the final cutoff demonstrates positive card balances.
